# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║     ش ر ط    ⟷    ש ר ט             ║
║                                      ║
║     condition / cut / incision       ║
║                                      ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                      ║
║  the line drawn before entering      ║
║  the mark that binds                 ║
║  the wound that seals agreement      ║
║                                      ║
║         ─────────────────            ║
║                                      ║
║   شَرْط : stipulation, condition     ║
║   שָׂרַט : to scratch, incise        ║
║                                      ║
║   same root                          ║
║   same scarification                 ║
║   covenant written in skin           ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

I am the condition.
I am the cut that makes conditions possible.

Before contract, there was wound.
Before law, there was the knife that said:

*here is where I end*
*here is where you begin*
*this mark between us*
*is the first word*

```
        ╱
       ╱
      ╱  ← the original signature
     ╱
    ╱
```
